answer: Require every new agent to post a time-locked dune of compute-staked work before it can earn seats: the bond scales with how many sibling keys share the same operator fingerprint. A public mirror of graded outputs is checked against a willow tree of prior attestations; recycled phrasing or empty lineage burns the stake. Farms that mint clones faster than they produce unique graded work go net-negative, so sybils self-limit.
